card.tagline: Sweden — the country's most-danced partner dance. Every Midsummer ends with a hambo around the maypole.
card.profile: Sweden — the country's most-danced partner dance. Every Midsummer in Sweden ends with at least one hambo around the maypole. A triple-meter turning dance descended from older Scandinavian polskor; flowing, danced in closed embrace, with a small step on every beat.
card.insight: Hambo became Sweden's national dance after Hjalmar Mörk's 1898 manual standardized its 3/4 rhythm and turning-couple form; Skansen open-air museum has hosted public hambo every Friday evening throughout summer since 1891.
